source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the News-Letter's nomination list of 8 May 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the seven electoral divisions of Moira rural district, one member each. All the retiring members were re-elected: five were nominated and returned unopposed, and no nominations were received for Ballyleney or Bleary. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
